# Ore & Steel Radar brief, 2026-11-11

1889 headlines scanned, 1576 relevant signals (2026-11-05 to 2026-11-11).

## Governance & Strategy
- **[9/10] Saudi Arabia opens an anti-dumping probe into hot-rolled steel sections imported from China and Türkiye.** Directly protects GCC heavy-section producers: duties would reduce Chinese and Turkish section competition in Saudi Arabia, our key market. *Action:* Prepare to support the probe with data; plan section sales growth in Saudi Arabia. ([SteelOrbis](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMixgFBVV95cUxObm9ZdUgyUGxGbUFyR3hiWXJiVUlib2F6WWNBT0hFZFo3WWpVQ2h0SzNjTmtQc1dSYTBwa3JGYl9jUG1wdFdFS2FuZkRYd0ZyZkVBaDQyamdQck1WWkZTdjI5bkNydi14bktzaDhvNGlKM0pUNnl1QWwzNm5zWF9TWmdBUWJYVkxJNW9FNms5aHZBMFExN0l5TFpiN2Fucm5CQzVPU3ktdUhqdnh0TFpZQXhhbzBWeHo4MEo2bHRLa1JJVUhIbWc?oc=5))
- **[9/10] Iran reports tankers on fire and fresh attacks on ships in the Strait of Hormuz; UKMTO confirms incidents and traffic stays at single digits.** Ore imports and pellet/steel exports through the Gulf face delays, higher freight and war-risk premiums; gas and power costs for DRP and meltshop stay elevated. *Action:* Raise ore stock cover, confirm alternative routes and lock freight and war-risk insurance for Q1 cargoes. ([The Jerusalem Post](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXEFVX3lxTFBRTllwOGdCRmVhUjZTRW9sWEplSVlIWGtpdUowU0p5S2thZ0IzWC1nUllWbk11SnY4SEdPeW5mTUFrMGNQaEJpR25OTF93ekl1b3M4by1RbHRqZXJm?oc=5))
- **[8/10] Ferrexpo temporarily suspends iron ore and pellet production in Ukraine after strikes disrupt power supply.** Removes a major seaborne pellet seller, mainly to Europe; supports pellet premiums and opens room for our pellets with European buyers. *Action:* Contact European pellet buyers Ferrexpo served; test spot pellet premiums. ([MESteel](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMimwFBVV95cUxPenRlMnNoLW05TkktUVMyc0Jpd3IzNlRqb29rQXBJZGplNi12V01DU2RadGx5Z01paV9NSEhrZUZiV3NwblVKdThlWUtJS0FjUEhWTDVQZjZfaFd6VDRRYWZxUkJtazNHTERvOS1uM3AxQkNCeTMzX01iNENpZlMtUzhWY1RjTUIwOHdVN1NmUktXQUxwS2FKdmxoaw?oc=5))
- **[8/10] Egypt cuts gas supplies to steel mills amid rising prices - GMK Center** Egyptian DRI-EAF output falls: less competition in MENA rebar and sections, possible demand for imported DRI/HBI or semis; shows gas risk for DRP. *Action:* Offer billets, sections or HBI to Egyptian buyers; review our own gas-supply risk. ([GMK Center](https://news.google.?oc=5))
- **[8/10] Simandou North mine project reported completed and in production.** More high-grade ore heads to market, pressuring iron ore prices (lower input cost for us) and adding a potential pellet-feed source. *Action:* Evaluate Simandou ore as pellet feed; update ore price outlook. ([Shanghai Metals Market](https://news.google.?oc=5))

- **[7/10] A deadly blast at the Habaş steel plant in Izmir, Türkiye, after an overhead crane fell into a furnace; arrests ordered.** Meltshop crane and furnace safety is in focus; Habaş outage may raise Turkish slab imports and cut its scrap and HRC supply. *Action:* Run a crane and meltshop safety check; watch Turkish semis and HRC demand. ([Khaleej Times](https://news.google.?oc=5))
